title: Integração e registro exclusivo
runtime_binding: launch-record.json, resolved by I00; never by the worker

canonical.inherit: All checks and five axiom families of each task, their WPs and campaign; resolve immutable pointers from ../criteria-trace.json.

depends_authoring.requires: FROZEN with digest in launch record
FROZEN with digest in launch record
FROZEN with digest in launch record

depends_qualification.candidate: Same material C plus authorized installed harness; source proofs retain their original SHA.

consumes.surface_spec: SURFACE-SPECS.md and exact entries in surface-manifest.json
consumes.microcopy: SURFACE-SPECS.md COPY-01 and source English field/action labels via FIELD-01. Shared new copy uses the frozen copy/key table; no labels_en/labels_pt keys are presumed in surface JSON.
consumes.component_signatures: COMPONENT-CONTRACTS.md and component-signatures.ts; exact named public types/callbacks and ownership of effects, no inferred props.
consumes.host_signatures: host-signatures.ts owns the exact public/private type placement, provider dependency injection, auth/navigation, broker IPC and host callbacks; no inference or private import into browser.

required_reads.source_pins: Read only relevant producer paths from SOURCE-BASELINE + contract-catalog source records, re-pinned by launch-record.

deliver: Emit immutable launch record with observed material SHA, authorized current stack writer, finite lane/lease allocation, source family pins and lock digests.
Apply only registration/composition glue from frozen fragments; 15 chapter entrypoints, route aliases and locale exports have one owner.
Consume leaf outputs incrementally using exact manifests, one candidate writer and existing validation dispatcher; never merge a source branch wholesale.
Publish native pilot cohort and per-chapter rollout manifests; preservation of legacy URLs/storage does not create a second business store.
Integrate the one metadata-only discovery endpoint in existing HttpApi and standard generated client exactly once; never add a dedicated generation target.
Merge new leaf dictionaries into existing packages/app-shell/src/i18n/orchestra.ts, preserving current ORCHESTRA_COPY/ORCHESTRA_COPY_BR composition; do not invent orchestra-chapters/index.ts.

Compose nativeUiProducts references in the exact owned host-context files and schedules.read in sfHumanReadActions per CONTRACTS §5.4; preserve explicit grant admission and leave canonical BusinessPorts/engines untouched.

Apply only the explicit package_exports entries; preserve all existing exports. No broad wildcard, dependency or lockfile change. Schema/Client callers import their public leaves through these entries.
Compose the approved connection registration hook in packages/app-shell/src/context/server.tsx with D01 registerConnection per host-signatures; bind never silently registers renderer-provided URLs.

Assemble metadata once from all catalog IDs, separately from the candidate-admitted codec map. Pilot registers only ctx plus A03 and dedicated auth/SDK operations; no runtime import of unintegrated families. Final readiness requires every catalog operation binding via its proper JSON/bytes/auth/SDK mode. A11 operations.ts remains the Operations family leaf.

Only after current producer writer release and S0/71 ACK: apply additive schemaVersion:2 native-view + landing CAS extension to existing personal-views.ts; legacy v1 bytes/response shape unchanged, no second persistence. A12/U43 consumers remain blocked until proof. Auth return-intents and nativeCommandPrecondition similarly require 72/73/74 release.

acceptance_cases.expected: Every imported entrypoint/export resolves to the exact admitted leaf output.
All changed paths are in the finite shared allowlist; foreign-owner changes require explicit release.
No material change is relabelled evidence-only; final C and D use canonical envelope.

Every frozen Schema/Client public leaf import resolves through the exact same-C package export map; the authorized compiler gate verifies the composed packages after real dependencies exist. No source-path/private import bypass.

Pilot metadata has the full catalog key set while codec imports are only admitted ctx/A03 leaves; F02 and D01 compile without the other 14 adapter implementations. Missing binding yields typed contract-unavailable before any network/dispatch. Final C resolves every catalog operation through its designated mode; no silent missing codec, fake handler or duplicate JSON auth wrapper.

gates.incremental: Use canonical ci_plan.dispatch_policy.incremental_validation and invalidation_matrix; exact changed specs plus transitive consumers, one dispatcher.
gates.execute_after: INTEGRATED and readiness satisfied; dispatcher resolves existing aliases before any request. Never invent workflow, runner or service.
gates.final: Canonical same-C gates remain; this work order cannot declare GLOBAL_RELEASE.
gates.typecheck_command: bun typecheck in each named package directory through the authorized compiler-only executor; never tsc directly.

stop: Unknown field, action, error, permission, route, export or schema => BLOCKED_CONTRACT for that output; publish exact question and source evidence; finish other independent authorized outputs.
Producer changed since locked family pin => BLOCKED_DRIFT for affected consumers; never silently rebase semantics or widen validation.
Required path outside owns or active foreign lease => BLOCKED_OWNER; provide complete inert patch to I00/current owner.
Live service absent => ARTIFACT_READY plus BLOCKED_INTEGRATION/QUALIFICATION; no stub, permissive substitute or synthetic receipt in production.
A failing unchanged input must not be rerun until causal change or a documented transient infrastructure cause is established.
No full-suite dispatch, merge, deploy, Azure, auth policy, financial rule or producer-engine change from this work order.

handoff.format: Canonical executor receipt plus protocol fields; source commit/tree, exact path/blob preimages/postimages, contracts digests, exports, tests not run/run evidence, blockers, consumer list, lease terminal.
handoff.slot_release: ARTIFACT_READY may be per named incremental output. After receipt and explicit owner handoff, release slot; next actor needs new bounded lease. No idle wait and no inferred expiry.
handoff.shared_changes: Exact proposed diff with preimage/postimage; I00 applies only after current owner release, without rewriting the author output.

write_modes.only: canonical packages/client bun run generate, once after integration, by current authorized generator/compiler custodian

entrypoints.signature: CONTRACTS §6.1–6.2 and host-signatures; complete closed metadata only, zero family imports.
Readonly candidate-admitted codec bindings per host-signatures; only actual included schemas, injected into transport/broker. Missing binding returns contract-unavailable before network, no fallback.
